doneWhen.text: `OtelConfig.sampler` (always/never/ratio/parent-based) and `OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER(_ARG)` (#7); `TracedHttpClient` (feature `platform`) opens a client span and calls `inject_into_http_request` (web.client#6, obs.tracing#6); `id_effect_sql` emits a `db.query` span with `db.system` and a parameter-free statement, bridged by `OtelSpanHook` (#6); `axum.rs` uses `.instrument(span)` instead of `span.enter()` across `.await`; `metrics.rs` doc links build without `pg`. Tests with the in-memory exporter `client_span_is_child_and_sends_traceparent`, `db_query_creates_span`, `ratio_sampler_from_env`, `server_span_not_held_across_await`. Book section in `ch27-00-observability.md`.
Gate: `cargo nextest run -p id_effect_opentelemetry -p id_effect_sql --all-features`; `cargo doc -p id_effect_sql --no-deps` with `RUSTDOCFLAGS=-D warnings`
